comment: The table of contract Annex B (120 names at C0: the EBAY_MKRID_/EBAY_SITEID_ templates expanded to six markets each) plus the rows added since by their readers' requests (REQ-WP01a-2, REQ-WP01b-2, REQ-WP16-14, WP19's own workflows). After C0 this file is the table: edit it directly (owner WP19, with WP21 for .env.example), keep Annex-B-style fields (kind, at, status, wp, default, where, wf, note, group). A row is only ever added or corrected, never deleted while a reader exists. Read by tests/env-names.test.ts.

retired.EBAY_AFFILIATE_CAMPAIGN: NEXT_PUBLIC_EBAY_CAMPAIGN_ID (client components can only read NEXT_PUBLIC_ names; the old name fell back to Rift's campaign in the browser)
retired.TCGPLAYER_IMPACT_LINK: NEXT_PUBLIC_TCGPLAYER_IMPACT_LINK (its default was Rift's partner link)
retired.HISTORY_DIR: PLANE_DIR (price history is files in the data repository; there is no second directory for it)
retired.HISTORY_RAW_BASE: PLANE_REPO and PLANE_BRANCH (the reader is plane/runtime.ts)
retired.HISTORY_REF: the pointer (latest.json) names the commit; nothing pins a ref by hand
retired.STRIPE_SITE: a constant of plans.ts, not a variable

DATABASE_URL.note: the ONE Neon project (pooled URL): private tables only (accounts, billing, watches, alerts, collection, notifications, newsletter, inbox, click events, ledger and eBay data, ImportRun/Meta). Public data is NOT in it (section 12). The importer does not read it ALSO the default home of the published data plane (table "PlaneFile", DECISIONS.md 2026-10-09): src/lib/data/plane/neon-store.ts is the only reader-side module that reaches it

MTG_LAB.note: directory of the research snapshot (scryfall/, tcgcsv/, design/magic-tools/ts-check/); the corpus tests skip when unset

TARGET_DATABASE_URL.default: none: the migrate-database task is a green no-op
TARGET_DATABASE_URL.note: the NEW Neon project of the maintenance task migrate-database (pg_restore target; private tables only). Read by the workflow alone; never a Vercel variable

VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA.note: baked into the build for /admin/deploys (the deployment's own commit)

GITHUB_ACTIONS.note: set by Actions: picks the build User-Agent of the Scryfall client

CI.note: set by Actions and most CI hosts: picks the build User-Agent of the Scryfall client

GITHUB_REPOSITORY.note: set by Actions: owner/name of THIS repository, for the keepalive age check

GITHUB_TOKEN.note: the workflow's own token (contents: read of this repository), for the keepalive age check; the data repository has its own token (DATA_REPO_TOKEN)

VERCEL.note: set by Vercel: the rate limiter trusts the platform's forwarded-address header only there

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.note: the domain (10.3); read in ONE file

SITE_URL.note: production origin for scripts, the importer's User-Agent and the deployment gate on Production

NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL.note: ONE contact address (requirements 1.4). The default ends in .invalid on purpose: a placeholder on a real domain would deliver every mailto to whoever owns it (WP16-site-identity-and-legal-strings)

NEXT_PUBLIC_EBAY_CAMPAIGN_ID.default: none: links render as plain eBay search links
NEXT_PUBLIC_EBAY_CAMPAIGN_ID.note: EPN campaign id, MTG's own (10.20). Replaces OP's EBAY_AFFILIATE_CAMPAIGN, which client components could not read (no NEXT_PUBLIC prefix) and which fell back to RIFT's id 5339155912 in the browser

NEXT_PUBLIC_TCGPLAYER_IMPACT_LINK.default: none: links render as plain TCGplayer links
NEXT_PUBLIC_TCGPLAYER_IMPACT_LINK.note: Impact link. Replaces OP's TCGPLAYER_IMPACT_LINK (default was Rift's partner link)

AUTH_SECRET.note: session signing; also verifies signed email links in scripts

ADMIN_TOKEN.note: scripts only, Authorization: Bearer, at least 32 characters

ADMIN_EXTRA_ORIGINS.note: extra origins (comma separated) an admin POST may come from in production, besides SITE_URL: a preview domain you administer from

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.default: none: the provider button is hidden

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.default: none: the provider button is hidden

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.default: none: the provider button is hidden

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.default: none: the provider button is hidden

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.note: the NEW MTG Compare Stripe account (test mode first). The site tag `site=mtgcompare` and the lookup keys `mtgcompare_*` are constants in plans.ts, not variables

CRON_SECRET.note: bearer secret: Vercel cron routes, the warm call /api/data-warm that every publish makes, and the purge of the Neon-backed tags /api/revalidate. Plane data needs no purge (pinned URLs)

REVALIDATE_URL.default: none: the warm call is skipped and logged (the site still reads the new pointer within 20 seconds)
REVALIDATE_URL.note: production origin: /api/data-warm and /api/data-status are called after every publish, /api/revalidate only for the Neon-backed tags

GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN.default: unset: the admin panels show a link to the workflow instead of a Run button
GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN.note: OPTIONAL fine-grained token, this repository only, Actions: write. Lets /admin/ebay and /admin/deploys dispatch a workflow. NOT an eBay credential

NEXT_PUBLIC_GITHUB_REPO.note: owner/repo used by the admin links and the unauthenticated release-history read

CLICK_LOG.note: 0 = outbound clicks are not recorded (owner decision 10.32); GA's buy_click is unaffected. Clicks are buffered in the instance and written in ONE insert inside the aligned half-hour window shared with the view counter (ClickBatcher)

CLICK_SAMPLE_RATE.note: 1 = every click (buffered); 0.1 = one in ten. Read only by ClickBatcher's caller

ALERT_DAILY_BUDGET.note: distinct addresses mailed per rolling day, free and paid runs together (price-alerts.ts alertDailyBudget)

OPS_WEBHOOK_URL.default: unset: ops alerts only print in the log
OPS_WEBHOOK_URL.note: Discord/Slack webhook for freshness, failure and store-health alerts (parity P39). Webhook only, no bot

EBAY_CLIENT_ID.default: none: eBay stays off (a green no-op run)
EBAY_CLIENT_ID.note: tests/no-ebay-api.test.ts: named only in src/lib/ebay*.ts and ebay-prices.yml. The workflow file name is ebay-prices.yml (one name, everywhere)
EBAY_CLIENT_ID.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_KEYSET_MODE.note: shared (Rift first, then MTG on the same quota) or own (10.1)
EBAY_KEYSET_MODE.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_OBSERVE_ONLY.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_API_ENABLED.note: KILL SWITCH (requirements 4): 0 = no Browse call at all
EBAY_API_ENABLED.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_DAILY_CALL_BUDGET.note: calls per day for MTG (requirements 4); the ledger enforces it
EBAY_DAILY_CALL_BUDGET.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_QUOTA_RESERVE.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_MAX_CALLS.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_MIN_VALUE_CENTS.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_DISPATCH_CAP.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_FORCE.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_ONLY_MARKET.note: restrict a manual run to one market
EBAY_ONLY_MARKET.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_REFRESH.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.note: Marketplace Account Deletion route; tests/no-ebay-api.test.ts pins the two names this route reads
EBAY_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

EBAY_DELETION_ENDPOINT.group: eBay (script-side only; the credentials are GitHub Actions secrets, never Vercel)

CATALOG_FLOOR_CENTS.note: every priced class-0 single has a row; 10, 25, 50 are the fallback ladder (5.6) (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
CATALOG_FLOOR_CENTS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

CATALOG_EXIT_RATIO.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

CATALOG_ORACLE_COMPLETE.note: every priced oracle keeps its TOP printing listed whatever the floor (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
CATALOG_ORACLE_COMPLETE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

INDEX_FLOOR_CENTS.note: a listed row below this score is THIN: noindex, no sitemap entry (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
INDEX_FLOOR_CENTS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

CATALOG_SPECIAL_FLOOR_CENTS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_FLOOR_CENTS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_EXIT_RATIO.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_LOW_BASIS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_POP_BOOST.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_PER_ORACLE_CAP.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

PRICE_CLIP_CENTS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

CATALOG_MAX_ROWS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TRACK_MAX_UNITS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

OFFER_ROWS_BUDGET.note: section 12 may re-express it in bytes (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
OFFER_ROWS_BUDGET.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_MAX_LISTED_CHANGE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_MAX_TRACKED_CHANGE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_ACCEPT_FLAG_CHANGE.note: 1 = accept this run's flag changes once (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
IMPORT_ACCEPT_FLAG_CHANGE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_GUARD_MAX_TRIPS.note: the Nth consecutive F10 trip is accepted (read only by trackConfigFromEnv)
IMPORT_GUARD_MAX_TRIPS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_MIN_PARSE_RATIO.note: a parse below this fraction of the last run aborts (F2, F4)
IMPORT_MIN_PARSE_RATIO.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

SCRYFALL_MODE.note: off = prices-only run keeping existing links (the library reads it; the two entry points pass it on)
SCRYFALL_MODE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_FORCE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_STORES.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_ONLY_STORES.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_ONLY_COUNTRY.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

SKIP_REVALIDATE.note: 1 = skip the warm call and the status poll after a publish (S13); the pointer has already moved
SKIP_REVALIDATE.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TCGCSV_CACHE_DIR.note: local response cache for offline re-runs
TCGCSV_CACHE_DIR.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

TCGCSV_LAST_UPDATED.note: ISO stamp of the TCGCSV day, used when <TCGCSV_CACHE_DIR>/last-updated.txt is absent (offline runs, the M1 bootstrap over a research download)
TCGCSV_LAST_UPDATED.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

SCRYFALL_CACHE_DIR.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

SCRYFALL_BACKOFF_MS.note: test dial: the wait before the one retry after a Scryfall 429
SCRYFALL_BACKOFF_MS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

IMPORT_CACHE_DIR.note: the Actions cache directory of the slim Scryfall file and the phase-1 to phase-2 match index
IMPORT_CACHE_DIR.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

BOOTSTRAP_GROUPS.note: N = restrict the first run to the N largest and newest groups
BOOTSTRAP_GROUPS.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

FEED_SOURCES.group: Importer and publisher (GitHub Actions variables, never Vercel variables)

PLANE_REPO.note: OPTIONAL: read only with PLANE_BACKEND=github (the default backend is Neon and needs none of it). owner/name of the PRIVATE data repository (12.4); the same value in Vercel and in Actions
PLANE_REPO.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_BRANCH.note: OPTIONAL: read only with PLANE_BACKEND=github (the default backend is Neon and needs none of it). the data branch; only the publisher writes it
PLANE_BRANCH.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_TOKEN.default: unset: reads are unauthenticated and a private repository answers 404 (the site serves its last good pointer and raises TOKEN_REJECTED)
PLANE_TOKEN.note: OPTIONAL: read only with PLANE_BACKEND=github (the default backend is Neon and needs none of it). fine-grained personal access token, Contents: read, on the data repository ONLY, at most 1 year (alarm 30 days before expiry). Part of the Data Cache key of every file: a rotation makes the cache cold and is followed by the data-hook workflow
PLANE_TOKEN.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_DIR.note: development, jobs and tests: a directory that holds v1/ (and optionally latest.json); no network, no token
PLANE_DIR.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_REMOTE.note: a git remote URL or local path that REPLACES https://github.com/<PLANE_REPO>.git: a bare repository for the drills and tests; unset in production
PLANE_REMOTE.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_WORK_DIR.note: where the clones of the data repository live
PLANE_WORK_DIR.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_LRU_MB.note: per-instance memory cache of parsed files
PLANE_LRU_MB.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_TIMEOUT_RAW_MS.note: per-file budget of the raw host before the API fallback
PLANE_TIMEOUT_RAW_MS.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_TIMEOUT_API_MS.note: per-file budget of the contents API fallback
PLANE_TIMEOUT_API_MS.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_ALLOW_PUBLIC.default: unset: a public data repository raises DATA_REPO_PUBLIC (error)
PLANE_ALLOW_PUBLIC.note: 1 = operate knowingly with a public data repository; the premium inputs and licensed data are then world-readable (12.3.3)
PLANE_ALLOW_PUBLIC.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

DATA_REPO_TOKEN.note: OPTIONAL: read only with PLANE_BACKEND=github (the default backend is Neon and needs none of it). fine-grained personal access token, Contents: write (and Administration: read for the size probe), on the data repository ONLY. GITHUB_TOKEN covers only the workflow's own repository. Travels in an http extraheader, never in a URL or a log
DATA_REPO_TOKEN.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

VIEW_BEACON_SAMPLE.note: the card-view counter samples one view in N and never counts a crawler; 1 = every view, 0 = off (12.12)
VIEW_BEACON_SAMPLE.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

VIEW_FLUSH_MINUTES.note: the counter writes to Neon at most this often per instance (scale-to-zero arithmetic: 12.12)
VIEW_FLUSH_MINUTES.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

NEXT_PHASE.note: set by Next while `next build` runs: the plane refuses every fetch then (the build reads no data)
NEXT_PHASE.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

GIT_CONFIG_COUNT.note: WRITTEN by authenticateGit() for every git child process (with GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0): the data-repository token travels in an http.extraheader, never in a URL or a log; read by git itself
GIT_CONFIG_COUNT.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

WORK_PACKAGES_JSON.note: development tooling: path of the work-package plan scripts/gen-ownership.ts turns into docs/ownership.json (the owner map the ratchets read)
WORK_PACKAGES_JSON.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

OWNERSHIP_WRITE_ANYWAY.note: development tooling: 1 writes docs/ownership.json although the plan has problems
OWNERSHIP_WRITE_ANYWAY.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

EMAIL_STATUS.note: on = pages may promise e-mail (mail secrets exist in Actions); environment only, never Neon

SET_SLUG.note: the set whose release-day blast runs

LIMIT.note: cap on recipients for one blast

PLANE_BACKEND.note: neon (the default, unset means neon): the published data lives in the PlaneFile table of DATABASE_URL, no token, no PLANE_REPO. github: the private data repository again (PLANE_REPO, DATA_REPO_TOKEN, PLANE_TOKEN). Set it in Vercel AND Actions, the same value in both
PLANE_BACKEND.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning

PLANE_POINTER_TTL_S.note: Neon backend only: how long an instance trusts its last read of the pointer row before looking again (stale-while-error on failure). Raise it to let Neon's compute suspend between visits
PLANE_POINTER_TTL_S.group: Data plane (section 12): the private data repository, its tokens, the reader's tuning
